caption: The drawing depicts two objects: a sabre and its scabbard, both illustrated with detailed attention to color and decoration. The sabre is positioned on the left side of the composition, slightly angled with its blade pointed downward to the right. The blade is metallic, rendered in shades of grey and silver, with darker engraved or etched details running along its length. The hilt of the sabre is ornate, colored gold with decorative elements, and its grip is black, featuring a wrapped or ribbed texture. The handguard is also gold and elaborately designed. To the right of the sabre is the scabbard, depicted vertically with its top end facing upward. The scabbard is primarily silver-grey with extensive gold embellishments at the throat, central section, and tip, showcasing intricate patterns. Two gold suspension rings are attached to the upper parts of the scabbard. The background is plain, allowing the details and colors of the sabre and scabbard to stand out clearly.
title: Sword and Sheath
